steps.content: Sunset Town is destroyed by the scorching heat. The disaster-stricken people have lost their homes. The Great Seer has gone missing, and the disasters are continuing. But people begin to notice changes.
The forest of crystal is spreading, and evil entities are gathering. Power awakens in the seer of the next generation. She hears the calls of Wraith Spirits in her dreams.
Amid the chaotic and unpredictable disasters, some strange yet familiar phenomena have occurred.

steps.speaker: Disaster Victim
steps.content: The sky tree stood, yet world lay waste. Vile dragon flew, the Sun Crow shone... The omens all correspond perfectly to the myth. Everything the Great Seer said was true. Everything in the myth is coming true!

steps.speaker: Disaster Victim
steps.content: Something is suppressing the Sun Crow's power! The sorcery left by the Great Seer is also starting to work!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The Great Seer is right about everything! The myth is true! And the Almighty Bow is now ready! But where did the Great Seer go? It's time for her to shoot the sun!

steps.speaker: Sealer
steps.content: ...The Great Seer has already set off to the battlefield. She's entrusted us with the Sun Shot. She told us to let the person with the most adamant faith draw the bow, for the belief of the archer will unleash the true power of the Almighty Bow.

steps.speaker: Sealer
steps.content: The archer must believe... that this arrow can settle the calamity.

steps.speaker: Young Scholar
steps.content: ...Give me the bow. I'll do it.

steps.speaker: Young Scholar
steps.content: No one has more faith in that liar than I do.

steps.speaker: The Great Seer
steps.content: Seers chanted, demons reveled.

steps.speaker: The Great Seer
steps.content: The end was near, the way back long.

steps.speaker: The Great Seer
steps.content: With rite and bow, revered fate must hold.

steps.speaker: The Great Seer
steps.content: Where sun sank low, my heart finds home...
Opening your eyes, you return to reality. You find yourself surrounded by a crowd, their faces stiff with concern and worry.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Ah... You're finally awake... Chief, your bravery can be frightening sometimes. Please prioritize your safety. You're too important to suffer any mishap.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm sorry.
Indeed, they have stressed this countless times before: Take care of yourself. The FAC will protect this city without you needing to risk your life.

You spread your palm that has reached out to that creature with the shackles. Quietly lying in your hand is an arrowhead burned with flames. This is the last trace that proves the person in the dream truly existed.
Meanwhile, the call connects.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the decoding is complete. Ambassador Du Ruo indeed left behind a considerable amount of research material, some of which seems to be... specially prepared for you.

options: Got it, I'll be right back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Du Ruo said she's waiting for a missing piece in DisCity. I have to find the final truth for her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Compile all the information Du Ruo accessed at the Bureau while Yanyan and I were away, including all the texts she left behind. I need all the clues.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The power of the Sun Shot first came from the myths believed by the people of the East. I'm sure there is something in DisCity that's worth everybody's faith.
